description: Why /indicador-operacao/validate is called without cTribNac: the calculator stores the NBS <-> cTribNac link at 4-digit granularity (ISS item + subitem) in db V0059, so the DPS 6-digit cTribNac (XSD TSCodTribNac, [0-9]{6}) is always rejected — valido=false even for the correct service code — while the documented 4-digit form (openapi pattern ^\d{4}$|^\d{6}$) answers valido=true. Sending serviceCode would false-reject every valid classification, and a truncated code would misattribute the single valido flag to operationIndicator. cTribNac existence keeps being validated by the local cTribNac JSON catalog (lookupServiceCode).
